payload.rationale: The packet establishes that Outfall 001 Part I nominates Pimephales promelas chronic WET testing at a Once/5 years frequency, requires WET testing at first discharge (footnote 2), and defers additional WET conditions to Part II (footnote 3). However, it does not supply the Part II WET requirements referenced by footnote (3), the date or occurrence of first discharge, prior WET test history needed to anchor the 5-year cycle, or discharge activity during Federal FY2025. The Once/5 years frequency alone does not establish that FY2025 is a required testing year without a cycle anchor; footnote (2) cannot be applied without first-discharge timing; and footnote (3) cannot be resolved without the Part II text. Neither the burden to establish that monitoring was required nor the burden to establish that it was not required is met. Per P5, unsupported uncertainty is preferred to unsupported semantic closure.
